question_text: What is the right course of action in this situation?

options.text: I continue driving as before
I brake hard immediately
I take a photograph of the scene of the accident

correct_answers.text: I continue driving as before

comment: It can be seen that the accident scene has already been adequately secured. For this reason, you should not brake sharply as this is unnecessary in this situation. A strong deceleration would only increase the risk of further accidents (especially rear-end collisions), since subsequent motorists do not expect a braking maneuver. While driving, photographing the accident is prohibited.

question_text: What is the right course of action now?

options.text: I reduce my speed
I continue driving as far to the left as possible
I continue driving as before

correct_answers.text: I reduce my speed
I continue driving as far to the left as possible

comment: On the right lane there was an accident and you drive towards the still unsecured accident site. Since the situation is not completely clear to you, you must reduce your speed. Drive as far to the left as possible to keep enough distance to the right-hand vehicles.

question_text: What is the right course of action now?

options.text: I reduce my speed further
I drive as far to the left as possible
I continue driving just as before

correct_answers.text: I reduce my speed further
I drive as far to the left as possible

comment: In the event of an accident, you should always play it safe and increase the safe distance as well as reduce your speed in case someone runs into the lane.

question_text: Your vehicle has collided with a wild animal. What is the right course of action here?

options.text: I secure the scene of the accident
I notify the police
I load the animal into my vehicle

correct_answers.text: I secure the scene of the accident
I notify the police

comment: After a deer accident, you should switch on the hazard warning lights, put on a high-visibility waistcoat and set up a warning triangle to secure the accident site. You should notify the police, describe your accident and give your exact location.

question_text: Why should you always carry the European accident report form with you on your journey?

options.text: - makes it easier to document the accident with foreign-speaking parties involved in the accident
- enables the parties involved to independently document the accident
- unambiguously clarifies the issue of liability at the scene of the accident

correct_answers.text: - makes it easier to document the accident with foreign-speaking parties involved in the accident
- enables the parties involved to independently document the accident

comment: The European Accident Report should be carried at all times, because it makes it easier to record accidents with people involved in the accident who speak other languages, and it enables the accident to be recorded independently.

question_text: How does an eCall system work in the event of a serious accident?

options.text: - the position of the motor vehicle
- the time of the accident
- the severity of the injuries of the persons in the motor vehicle

correct_answers.text: - the position of the motor vehicle
- the time of the accident

comment:
In the event of severe car accidents, for which, for example, airbags trigger, the ECALL system automatically sets a 112 emergency call. He transmits the accident clock time and the exact location.
Alternatively, vehicle occupants can also trigger an SOS signal manually-for example with a heart attack by the passenger.

question_text: In what situation is the eCall system designed to be triggered manually?

options.text: If I am witness to a serious accident
If a passenger suffers a medical emergency
If my vehicle sustains a puncture

correct_answers.text: If I am witness to a serious accident
If a passenger suffers a medical emergency

comment: The emergency call system can also be triggered manually in the event of an urgent medical problem, e.g. with a heart attack of the moving, passing or as a helping, in a serious accident.

question_text: You have an accident on the autobahn with your truck. In which order do you proceed?

options.text: Stop immediately, ensure traffic safety, check the effects of the accident and help any injured persons
Stop immediately, find witnesses, ensure traffic safety and help injured persons
Stop, call the police, switch on your hazard warning lights and wait

correct_answers.text: Stop immediately, ensure traffic safety, check the effects of the accident and help any injured persons

comment: In an accident with your truck on a highway, you should immediately stop, secure traffic and make out about the accident and potential injuries to help.

question_text: While you are travelling on the autobahn, your passengers tell you there is smoke in the bus. What must you do?

options.text: Stop immediately on the hard shoulder and secure the vehicle at a sufficient distance
Direct your passengers to a location at a safe distance away from the bus and autobahn
Drive on to the next petrol station to get help

correct_answers.text: Stop immediately on the hard shoulder and secure the vehicle at a sufficient distance
Direct your passengers to a location at a safe distance away from the bus and autobahn

question_text: Your bus overturns in an accident and you cannot open the doors. What must you do?

options.text: Tell the passengers to leave the bus through the emergency windows and emergency doors and to remain calm
Ask uninjured passengers to help bring injured and frail persons and children out of the bus safely
First wait for help

correct_answers.text: Tell the passengers to leave the bus through the emergency windows and emergency doors and to remain calm
Ask uninjured passengers to help bring injured and frail persons and children out of the bus safely

question_text: You are involved in a pile-up accident on the autobahn in fog. Your bus is wedged in by other vehicles. What must you do?

options.text: Take injured persons and passengers to a place at a safe distance from the bus and autobahn and give first aid
Once you have evacuated the passengers to safety, return to the scene of the accident
First, look for witnesses at the scene of the accident

correct_answers.text: Take injured persons and passengers to a place at a safe distance from the bus and autobahn and give first aid
Once you have evacuated the passengers to safety, return to the scene of the accident

question_text: You break down and have to stop on the right hand hard shoulder of an autobahn. What must you do?

options.text: Switch on your hazard warning lights and place warning signs (safety devices) at a sufficient distance behind the vehicle
Ensure that your passengers remain at a safe distance away from the bus and autobahn
Call for help unless you can repair the vehicle yourself

correct_answers.text: Switch on your hazard warning lights and place warning signs (safety devices) at a sufficient distance behind the vehicle
Ensure that your passengers remain at a safe distance away from the bus and autobahn
Call for help unless you can repair the vehicle yourself

question_text: Who is a party involved in an accident?

options.text: A person whose conduct may have contributed to the accident
A person who has caused the accident
A person who is a witness to what happened

correct_answers.text: A person whose conduct may have contributed to the accident
A person who has caused the accident

comment: A participant in a traffic accident can be a person whose conduct has contributed to the selfsame and a person who caused the accident.

question_text: Does the person involved in an accident have to move his/her vehicle to the side?

options.text: Yes, in the case of minor damage
Yes, in any case
No, never

correct_answers.text: Yes, in the case of minor damage

comment: A participant in the accident should drive his vehicle aside if only minor damage. So that traffic can continue to flow.

question_text: You are involved in a traffic accident. To ensure that passengers are not endangered, they must leave the bus. However, it is no longer possible to open the doors of your bus. What must you do now?

options.text: - calm the passengers
- request that the passengers use the emergency exits in the event of an emergency
- request the passengers to assist one another

correct_answers.text: - calm the passengers
- request that the passengers use the emergency exits in the event of an emergency
- request the passengers to assist one another

comment:
If you are involved in a traffic accident and the doors do not open, you should first calm down the passengers.
Ask the passengers to leave the vehicle via the designated emergency outputs and ask the passengers to help each other.

question_text: While driving your bus on the motorway you become involved in a road traffic accident. The passengers need to disembark from the bus. What is the right course of action?

options.text: I inform the passengers about the situation
I have to issue clear instructions about how to leave the bus safely
I have to remove my driver card from the tachograph

correct_answers.text: I inform the passengers about the situation
I have to issue clear instructions about how to leave the bus safely

comment: The first thing you should do is reassure the passengers and inform them of the situation. Then give the passengers clear instructions, ask them to leave the vehicle via the designated emergency exits and ask them to help each other.
